# Suede Universe Map

> A plain-English, live-verified map of the entire Suede Labs AI ecosystem: every site, app, and tool, what each is for, how they connect, and which link to click. Maintained by Suede Labs AI, founded by Jason Colapietro, who creates under the declared alias Johnny Suede.

The map reads top to bottom as a public operating graph: Jason Colapietro (the founder), JC Investment Group LLC (an active Florida LLC whose public filing lists Jason as manager), Suede Labs AI (the operating brand), and the publicly connected tools and sites below. The JC Investment Group LLC filing is dated June 3, 2019 under Florida document L19000146068.

Official identity pages: [Jason Colapietro](https://jasoncolapietro.com) and [Johnny Suede](https://johnnysuede.com).

Claim boundary: this public operating map documents public pages, links, filings, and stated roles. It does not establish legal title, parent/subsidiary relationships, or ownership percentages.

## Map

- [The Suede Universe Map](https://map.suedeai.ai/): Public operating graph from founder to entity to brand to every publicly connected product, plus a "which link do I click" router table.
- [Investor deck](https://map.suedeai.ai/deck/): Ecosystem investor deck.
- [Press kit](https://map.suedeai.ai/press/): Press assets and background.

## Core Suede properties

- [Suede Labs AI](https://suedeai.ai): The flagship product site.
- [suedeai.org](https://suedeai.org): Thesis, books, and investor information.
- [Suede Hub](https://hub.suedeai.ai): Live, browsable index of every shipped product.
- [Suede Docs](https://docs.suedeai.ai): Developer documentation, mirroring github.com/Suede-AI/suede-docs.
- [Founder profile](https://suedeai.ai/founder): Jason Colapietro, who creates under the declared alias Johnny Suede, Founder and CEO of Suede Labs AI.

## Optional

- [Suede SEO](https://seo.suedeai.ai): GEO, PR and reputation retainer. Captures what ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI results say about a business, then repairs the pages those engines read.
